name: Blue Lights
description: Follows rookie police officers working in Belfast, a city in which being a frontline response cop comes with unique pressures and dangers.

videos.title: The Code
videos.overview: PSNI probationer Grace promises to help Angela, whose son has fallen in with a notorious gang. But with undercover agents watching, will she be able to keep her word?

videos.title: Bad Batch
videos.overview: The team scramble to deal with a bad batch of drugs while the McIntyres try to cover their tracks. Annie receives terrifying news that has her wondering who she can trust.

videos.title: The Fear
videos.overview: A paramilitary-style assault case has Grace determined to bring the McIntyres to their knees. When Gordy pulls away from Angela, she becomes desperate for help.

videos.title: Full Moon Fever
videos.overview: The police ombudsman investigates the team after a disastrous night shift. Helen uncovers a scandal, while a crisis at home has Grace doubting her career choice.

videos.title: The Q Word
videos.overview: Mo’s side deal goes ahead, risking his relationship with his father. Tommy’s firearms exam is brought forward, and Stevie tries to convince Grace to come back to work.

videos.title: Love The One You're With
videos.overview: The team work together after the shooting. Stevie clashes with the spooks, Mo learns the truth about his father, and Grace accepts that she might break her promise to Angela.

videos.title: This Too Shall Pass
videos.overview: A year into the job, the team are faced with a drug-fuelled crime wave that leads them into a loyalist estate. A violent clash puts Stevie and Grace’s working relationship at risk.

videos.title: Iceberg
videos.overview: A loyalist gangland feud turns up the pressure on the section. Annie makes an impetuous decision on a night out.

videos.title: Love Knows
videos.overview: As tensions grow in Mount Eden, a response call forces Stevie to confront his past. Annie deals with the consequences of an impulsive decision.

videos.title: The Stamp of Nature
videos.overview: Lee is the new boss in Mount Eden. Under pressure from Canning to get results, Shane leads Tommy into danger.

videos.title: Where I Want to Be
videos.overview: Annie’s job is on the line. As Lee consolidates power, Stevie and Grace are thrown back together on a response call, with terrible consequences.

videos.title: The Loyal
videos.overview: Mount Eden descends into chaos as Grace tries to get Henry out from under Lee’s control. Happy finally learns the truth.

videos.title: The Party
videos.overview: The arrest of young drug dealer Sandy McKnight begins to expose a criminal conspiracy involving every level of Belfast’s society, from wealthy businesswoman Dana Morgan to vulnerable teenager Lindsay Singleton.

videos.title: Skipper
videos.overview: A car crash has traumatic consequences for Aisling, while the fallout creates a deadly situation for the section. Grace turns to child protection to try and help Lindsay.

videos.title: The Bird
videos.overview: Grace and Shane push boundaries for Lindsay’s sake as a threat closes in. Aisling and Tommy respond to a call-out where things are not as they seem, with unexpected consequences.

videos.title: The Parting Glass
videos.overview: Grace offers up a secret about her own past in an attempt to connect to Lindsay. Aisling’s erratic behaviour forces Tommy to make a heartbreaking decision.

videos.title: Ordo ab Chao
videos.overview: Grace and Sean bring in George for questioning, leading Morgan to take drastic measures to silence him. Shane faces an unexpected situation on a routine call-out.

videos.title: World of Our Own
videos.overview: Grace and Sean are under serious threat, while Lindsay's testimony exposes the Ginleys. Colly takes a risk to go after Morgan, and Fogerty decides Tina is no longer useful.

awards: Won 1 BAFTA Award4 wins & 8 nominations total
